notes.scope: Application-owned source, tests, tools, configuration, and root launchers; both current and planned English directories are covered.
notes.assets: Models, fonts, archives, reports, ur10 upstream code, and compiled web bundles are excluded. Frontend generated source is included and must be fixed through its generator.
notes.string_keys: Non-ASCII literal object/dictionary keys need human classification: some are machine fields, others are user-visible labels. They are reported separately and do not fail the incremental gate.
